item.title: Forum Criticism Team - Junior Staff Post
item.content:encoded:
Doctor Sunnus, per the required forum guidelines:

Do not link to a sandbox unless a reviewer asks to see a draft.

Instead, please use the standardized template for concepts found here: http://www.scp-wiki.net/forum/t-13282684/required-reading:how-to-use-this-forum-ideas

Additionally, please do not copy-paste portions of a sandbox draft into the template in lieu of actually filling out the sections. If you are unsure of what the post should look like, look around other threads within this forum.

Once you have reviewed the guidelines, please edit your post to the correct format rather than creating a new thread, and if you are having trouble editing, click the "edit" function under the "options" tab to the lower right of your post. Please feel free to then reach out to a reviewer for your concept: http://www.scp-wiki.net/forum/t-13282692/how-to-get-more-reviews

item.title: Time Distorting Shower
item.content:encoded:
Good evening,

this is my first attempt creating an SCP.
I am looking forward to your feedback.

~Florian

EDIT: Thank you Truc Linh, I've change the style.

Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre: Mystical

Page Layout: In descending order: Containment Procedures, Description, Addenda & Experiments, Summary. Information is thought to be layered, meaning that the more you read, the more background information you get. It won't be necessary to read the addenda and experiments, but it will certainly give the reader a better understanding of what they are dealing with.

Elevator Pitch: This SCP represents a shower that is able to distort the time for individuals inside the cabin.

Central Narrative:

  • SCP came to the attention of the foundation when a field agent, working in a hospital, recieves a call from a person saying that he does not age
  • Investigation is initiated and the SCP is recovered.
  • A bunch of experiments are conducted to understand how exactly the SCP manages to distort time (Class D Personnel is sent into the cabin under different circumstances)

Hook/Attention-Grabber: The time distortion is based on the thoughts and emotions of the subject showerig. If a subject is completely aware of the situation and focuses on the time, nothing will happen. Furthermore, the capabilities of the SCP are not yet fully understood, and the mind of the reader should be stimulated to come up with their own experiements - What would they do? What experiments are possible?

Additional Notes: The article is already written - if you want the full version, just let me know.
